subject: Confidential: Initiate performance support plan for Ethan Park
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T08:15:00Z
Subject: Request to start formal performance plan for Ethan Park

Hi Kim / Laura (and looping Aditya for legal visibility),

I'm writing to request HR and legal guidance to move from informal coaching to a formal performance support plan for Ethan Park (IC, Mobile). Over the past 5 months I've documented repeated misses against delivery commitments and persistent quality gaps on the payments integration work. I've attached an evidence packet with dated examples, missed milestones, and 1:1 notes.

Summary of concerns (short):
- Missed or late delivery on three sprints (Dec–Feb), two of which required rollbacks.
- Repeated code quality issues that required senior intervention (PR rework).
- Declining responsiveness to code review feedback and missed QA windows.

I've drafted a PIP template and an initial 30/60/90 day plan — attached as draft_pip_template.docx. My proposed next steps:
1) HR + Legal review the attached materials and advise on form wording and timeline.
2) Schedule a private meeting with Ethan this week (I propose Thu 3/12 4pm or Fri 3/13 10am).
3) Assuming HR/legal approval, issue the formal plan and log the case in HRIS.

Important constraints: confidentiality — please keep circulation limited to the people on this thread.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Mobile
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to start formal performance plan for Ethan Park

Thanks for the summary and for keeping this tight, Rishi. I reviewed the evidence_packet.zip and the draft. A few quick notes before legal weighs in: 

- Template: I updated phrasing around measurable success criteria and added a 2-week check-in cadence. See PIP_template_v2.docx (attached).
- Timeline: For fairness and documentation, we usually allow a 30–60 day active improvement window for an IC at this level, with weekly checkpoints. Recommend starting the formal plan no earlier than Mon 3/15 to give us time to finalize wording and prepare the meeting talking points.
- Confidentiality & disclosure: Remind the manager to have a private, in-person-style (Zoom but one-on-one) conversation and to avoid copying beyond HR/legal.

I'll reserve time Thu 3/12 4pm but hold as tentative until legal confirms. I'll also open an HRIS case after we have final wording.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T14:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to start formal performance plan for Ethan Park

Rishi / Kim — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick legal read:

- Documentation: Evidence looks sufficient for a performance-based action; ensure dates and impacts are clearly mapped (you already did this well).
- Wording: Avoid speculative language ("seems" / "appears"); use concrete examples and stated expectations. I've attached redlines_20270312.pdf with suggested edits to the PIP_template_v2.docx.
- Termination considerations: If the plan fails, follow the documented escalation path. We'll want an approval ticket before final termination decisions (I can draft the optional termination checklist).
- Privacy: Keep the distribution minimal; do not place evidence files in a shared drive without access controls — HRIS is preferred for record-keeping.

I'm comfortable with the proposed timing (target start 3/15). If there are any potential disability or accommodation flags, flag them to me immediately — I did a quick check and there are no open accommodations on Ethan's profile.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: ethan_park <ethan@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-12T16:00:00Z
Subject: Private: Meeting request to discuss performance support plan

Ethan,

I'd like to meet privately to discuss your role and performance over the last few months. This is a confidential, supportive conversation — the goal is to align on expectations and next steps. Can you meet Thu 3/12 at 4:30pm or Fri 3/13 at 10:00am? Please confirm a time that works and I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Agenda (brief):
- Summary of recent work and examples
- Manager feedback and expectations
- Potential support and timeline for improvement
- Opportunity for you to share context and questions

If you'd prefer to have someone from People present, let me know.

Thanks,
Rishi

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed the redlines and the timeline. I'm authorizing you to proceed with a formal performance support plan starting Mon 3/15, pending the meeting outcome. A few leadership notes: 

- Keep coaching tone constructive and focused on outcomes; document the meeting notes in HRIS within 24 hours.
- For the first 30 days, pair Ethan with a peer reviewer for critical PRs to reduce production risk.
- If the employee requests an accommodation or brings up medical concerns, pause and escalate to Legal immediately (Aditya).

I'll ask People Ops to open approval_ticket_4721 and set the retention policy to private. Kim: please file the case and attach the evidence packet; Aditya: please keep the redlines for our records.

Laura Bennett
VP, People
Redwood Inference
